title: 第263章 打破全军记录！？恐怖至极的身体素质！会赢吗？
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

还记得之前说过，针对于这种多项目大型演武比赛，我部战区一直是会遵守田忌赛马的逻辑去分配体力。

即第一关五公里武装越野能拿到好名次最好，拿不到的话只要不落下太多分，

他们就会选择保存体力将状态留给后续其他项目的。

但考虑到现在正在和他们进行比拼的队伍并不是什么国际顶尖高手，也不是其他战区的兵王。

此时和他们并列的，仅仅是一些在二三十岁年纪就退伍的正常退伍兵，

所以飞龙这些人不能说真的有在轻视对面吧，

但也多少是有点打算直接在起步阶段就给这些家伙一个下马威尝尝，

于是在号令枪声刚一响起，他们的身形就如同猎豹一般猛然窜了出去！

明明身上背着有整整三十斤的武装负重，

明明需要用手一直扶好胸前枪支以确保在遭遇敌人时第一时间能够举枪迎敌，

这些也丝毫没有能影响他们的速度！

（PS：稍微好让你们代入一下就是，在三角洲同样负重的情况下，人物持枪跑和切刀跑的速度以及体力消耗是完全不一样的，比赛现在被要求的就是持枪跑。）

短短不过是一分钟的时间，就已经跑完了五公里武装越野第一阶段的一半。

没错，通过各大战区都有的，包括一些电竞俱乐部内也有的数据分析师的公开数据。

一般来说，正规的五公里武装越野一共分为这五个阶段，分别是第一阶段的起步热身。

走的是硬化路+约5度的上坡，无障碍。

第二阶段的碎石路+独木桥+1米矮墙旨在考验一个人的平衡与核心能力。

第三阶段的连续抖坡，泥泞土路。

第四阶段的下坡+林间不规则小路以及最后第五阶段的最后平路与一百米的高度上坡。

而虽然仅从这样的一个角度去看觉得这第一阶段的一公里路好像不是很困难的样子，

但实际上若是按照大众标准来看，能跑到三分钟内的都已经算是团级尖子的程度了！

也就只有像是飞龙特种大队这种真正的战区级精英，外加想要给退伍老兵来一点年轻人震撼、

所以在前第一阶段确实是有刻意提速一点。

他们才会在平均一分多钟的时间跑完了第一阶段的一半，并预计再过多一分半钟，

也就是合两分四十秒左右就能跑完这五公里武装越野的第一阶段。

成绩要足足要超过现役标准士兵一分钟整！

“队长，我们现在这个速度可是比正常演练的时候都要快了，他们现在估计已经被拉到后面看不见了吧！”

虽然全力跑步的时候士兵们肯定是不会说话，更不会如此进行调侃的。

但仅从飞龙大队此时跑在最前方两位选手间的眼神交流，其实就已经大概能看出来对方此时的内心所想，

翻译过来差不多就是上面这句话了。

但就在他们一边这样想着，一边稍微往回头看了一眼之后，可以看到的是，

他们那原本轻松且带着轻视的眼神之中顿时就流露出了一抹惊色。

因为——和他们刚才内心所想的，身后这一队退伍兵甚至还不一定能达到普通士兵标准，

也就是差他们足足一分钟时间以及至少一二百米距离，让他们估计快要看不到身后人的情况不同。

不只是那个唯一让他们感觉到有点军人气质的“威龙”，就连一些看起来已经上了年纪，

就连对方队伍里那唯一一个女兵，她都能稳稳的跟上大部队，死死追在他们的身后并没有被拉开距离！

甚至说，即便是自己等人，

因为刚才确实是有想给他们一个下马威，所以他们的起步速度确实不符合正常的体力分配，

所以现在在一口气冲了接近七百米后都难免有些呼吸不稳，喘气也都有些粗重了。

但反观身后....不，或者说现在已经几乎并排的威龙等人，他们的呼吸却完全看不出来紊乱，

就连那个女兵也是一样，这是什么情况？

这是什么体能？

这体能绝对不对，绝对不是正常士兵所能做到的，更别说是退伍兵了！

难道他们都是假退伍，真兵王？

是首长派过来打压他们锐气的？

来不及再去胡思乱想那么多，再想就真的要彻底掌控不了呼吸了。

Page (1/3)

I still remember what I said before, for this kind of large-scale multi-event martial arts competition, our theater has always followed the logic of Tian Ji's horse racing to allocate physical strength.

That is to say, it is best to get a good ranking in the first five-kilometer armed cross-country. If you can't get it, as long as you don't lose too many points,

They will choose to save their physical strength and leave the status for other subsequent projects.

But considering that the team currently competing with them is not the top international expert, nor is it the king of soldiers in other theaters.

At this time, juxtaposed with them were just some normal veterans who retired from the army in their twenties and thirties.

So it can't be said that people like Feilong are really looking down on their opponents, right?

But it was somewhat planned to give these guys a taste of power in the initial stage.

So as soon as the order gun sounded, their bodies suddenly rushed out like cheetahs!

He was obviously carrying a full thirty kilograms of armed weight.

Obviously you need to hold the gun on your chest with your hand to ensure that you can raise the gun to meet the enemy immediately when encountering the enemy.

None of this affects their speed at all!

(PS: To give you some perspective, under the same load in the delta, the speed and physical consumption of the character running with a gun and running with a cutter are completely different. What is required in the game now is running with a gun.)

In just one minute, half of the first stage of the five-kilometer armed cross-country was completed.

That's right, through the public data available from data analysts in all major theaters, including some e-sports clubs.

Generally speaking, the formal five-kilometer armed cross-country is divided into these five stages, which are the first stage of starting and warming up.

We walked on a hardened road + about 5 degrees of uphill slope, no obstacles.

The second stage of the gravel road + single-plank bridge + 1-meter low wall is designed to test a person's balance and core abilities.

The third stage is continuous slope shaking and muddy dirt roads.

The fourth stage is downhill + irregular paths in the forest, and the fifth stage is the final flat road and an uphill climb of 100 meters.

And although looking at it from this perspective, the one-kilometer journey in the first stage does not seem to be very difficult,

But in fact, if we look at it by public standards, anyone who can run within three minutes is considered to be at the top of the regiment!

There are only real theater-level elites like the Feilong Special Forces Brigade, plus those who want to give veterans a little bit of youth shock,

So in the first stage, we did deliberately speed up the process a little bit.

They will finish half of the first stage in an average of just over one minute, and are expected to take another minute and a half longer.

In other words, it takes about two minutes and forty seconds to complete the first stage of the five-kilometer armed cross-country.

The performance must be one full minute higher than the standard soldier on active duty!

"Captain, our current speed is faster than during normal drills. They must have been pulled behind and out of sight now!"

Although the soldiers certainly couldn't speak when they were running at full strength, let alone make fun of them like this.

But just from the eye contact between the two players running at the front of the Feilong Team, we can actually roughly tell what the other player is thinking at this time.

The translation is almost the above sentence.

But as they were thinking this and looking back slightly, what they could see was,

Their originally relaxed and contemptuous eyes suddenly showed a look of surprise.

Because - and what they were thinking just now, the group of veterans behind them may not even meet the standards of ordinary soldiers.

In other words, there was a full minute difference between them and a distance of at least one to two hundred meters, which made them almost unable to see the people behind them.

Not only was the "Vyron" the only one that made them feel a bit military, but some of them looked older.

Even the only female soldier in the opponent's team was able to steadily keep up with the large army, chasing after them without losing any distance!

He even said that even if he is waiting for others,

Because I really wanted to give them a head start just now, so their starting speed did not meet the normal physical distribution.

So now after rushing nearly 700 meters in one breath, it is inevitable that my breathing is a little unsteady, and my breathing is a little heavy.

But looking behind me... no, or in other words, Weilong and others who are almost side by side now, their breathing can't be seen to be disordered at all.

Even the female soldier is the same. What is going on?

What kind of physical ability is this?

This kind of physical fitness is absolutely wrong, and it is definitely not something that normal soldiers can do, let alone veterans!

Could it be that they are all fake veterans and are the real soldiers?

Was it sent here by the chief to suppress their enthusiasm?

There is no time to think so much anymore, and if you think about it again, you will really lose control of your breathing.
